BM25 filter with zero threshold passes all pages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, crawl, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(bm25_query="unrelated query", bm25_threshold=0.0, content_filter="bm25", max_depth=1)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))

asyncio.run(main())
```
